chunks.head: seen better days
chunks.note: 字面“见过更好的日子”,指人或物曾经辉煌、如今落魄。常用完成式 have seen better days。
chunks.ex_en: This old coat has seen better days.
chunks.ex_cn: 这件旧外套早已不如从前了。

chunks.head: well-to-do
chunks.note: 形容词,指经济宽裕、生活富足,常修饰人或家庭。

literal.note_cn: 整体已固化为形容词,不按字面理解

chunks.ex_en: They come from a well-to-do family.
chunks.ex_cn: 他们出身于一个富裕的家庭。

chunks.head: with a relish
chunks.gloss: 津津有味地;带着享受地
chunks.note: relish 意为“享受、兴致”;with a relish 表示做某事时很投入、很过瘾。

literal.note_cn: 此处作名词,非“调味品”义

chunks.ex_en: He ate the noodles with a relish.
chunks.ex_cn: 他津津有味地吃着面条。

chunks.head: regarded as
chunks.note: regard sb/sth as … 把……看作……;常用被动 be regarded as。
chunks.ex_en: She is regarded as the best singer in her class.
chunks.ex_cn: 她被认为是班里唱得最好的。

chunks.head: get rid of
chunks.note: 非常常用,后接想要除去的人、物或麻烦。

literal.note_cn: 只用于 get/be rid of 这一固定搭配

chunks.ex_en: I want to get rid of these old shoes.
chunks.ex_cn: 我想把这些旧鞋子扔掉。

chunks.head: go into details
chunks.note: go into 后接内容表示“深入谈及”;go into details 即“讲细节”。
chunks.ex_en: He didn't go into details about the accident.
chunks.ex_cn: 他没有细说那场事故的细节。

chunks.head: keep up
chunks.note: 表示让某事物持续不衰;也可指“跟上(进度)”。此处指风俗被沿袭保留。
chunks.ex_en: Let's keep up this good habit.
chunks.ex_cn: 咱们把这个好习惯保持下去吧。

chunks.head: by and by
chunks.note: 略显文气的时间副词短语,表示“过了一会儿、慢慢地”。

literal.note_cn: 整体为习语,不逐字直解

chunks.ex_en: By and by the rain stopped.

chunks.head: said to himself
chunks.note: say to oneself 表示“暗自想、在心里说”,不一定出声。
chunks.ex_en: He said to himself that he must not give up.
chunks.ex_cn: 他心里想,自己绝不能放弃。

chunks.head: be lost on
chunks.note: sth be lost on sb:某事(道理、玩笑等)没能被某人理解或打动。

literal.meaning_cn: 失去作用的(lose的过去分词)
literal.note_cn: 此处非“丢失”,指“白费、没起效”

chunks.ex_en: The joke was lost on the little kids.
chunks.ex_cn: 这个笑话小孩子们根本没听懂。

chunks.head: long for
chunks.note: long 作动词表示“强烈渴望”,后接名词或 to do。
chunks.ex_en: She longed for a cup of hot tea.

chunks.head: turn over
chunks.note: 指把物体或身体翻转到另一面。
chunks.ex_en: Turn over the pancake so it cooks on both sides.
chunks.ex_cn: 把煎饼翻个面,好让两面都熟。

chunks.head: little by little
chunks.note: 强调缓慢而持续的变化过程。
chunks.ex_en: Little by little, he learned to swim.
chunks.ex_cn: 他一点一点地学会了游泳。

chunks.head: let go
chunks.note: let (sth) go 松手放开;宾语常插在中间,如 let it go。
chunks.ex_en: Hold the rope tight and don't let go.

chunks.head: look upon ... as
chunks.note: look upon (= look on) sb/sth as …:以某种眼光看待某人某物;宾语与 as 之间常隔开。
chunks.ex_en: They look upon him as a hero.

chunks.head: carry off
chunks.note: 把东西带走或抢走;宾语为代词时插在中间,如 carry it off。
chunks.ex_en: The thief tried to carry off the painting.
chunks.ex_cn: 小偷企图把那幅画偷走。
